zh.title: 民航局宣佈國內線明日全數取消 國際航班仍可能調整
zh.summary: 民航局宣佈國內線明日全數取消，國際線仍可能調整。
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，依國籍業者提供的最新動態，明日國內線全數取消；國際線也可能因颱風因素持續調整。民航局提醒旅客留意航班異動，並在出發前向航空公司確認航班動態。
民航局統計，截至今日18時，國內線已有126架次取消，國際線取消40架次，主要是往返日本沖繩的航班。為在颱風來襲前疏運滯留旅客，民航局協調立榮航空及華信航空於今日上午分別加開高雄—澎湖、臺北—澎湖航線班機各2架次。

en.title: Taiwan CAA Says All Domestic Flights Will Be Canceled Tomorrow
en.summary: Taiwan’s CAA says domestic flights are canceled tomorrow; international schedules may also change.
body: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration said all domestic flights are scheduled to be canceled tomorrow, based on the latest information provided by local operators. International flights may also continue to be adjusted in response to the typhoon’s movement. The authority urged passengers to follow flight updates and confirm their flight status with their airline before departure.

The authority reported that 126 domestic flights and 40 international flights had been canceled as of 18:00 today. It said the international cancellations mainly involved flights to and from Okinawa. To move stranded passengers before the typhoon’s arrival, the authority coordinated with 立榮航空 and 華信航空 to add two flights each this morning: one on the Kaohsiung–Penghu route and one on the Taipei–Penghu route.

zh.title: 奇瑞公佈兩款凌霄電動垂直起降概念機
zh.summary: 奇瑞在蕪湖年度大會公佈兩款凌霄電動垂直起降概念機
body: 奇瑞在年度全球創新大會公佈兩款「凌霄」品牌電動垂直起降（eVTOL）概念機。大會於2026年10月20日在安徽省蕪湖舉行。報導指出，兩項飛行器計畫目前的狀態與開發時程資訊有限。凌霄Q212為雙座全電動機型，採複合翼及升力與巡航推進架構，最高速度可達每小時120公里，滿載飛行續航約一小時。
另一款概念機凌霄J506為五座傾轉旋翼機。報導指出，兩款飛行器均為有人駕駛；凌霄J506據報設計上也可能支援自主飛行。

en.title: Chery unveils two Lingxiao eVTOL concepts at annual conference
en.summary: Chery unveiled two Lingxiao eVTOL concepts at its conference in Wuhu.
body: Chery announced two eVTOL concepts under its Lingxiao brand at its annual Global Innovation Conference, held in Wuhu in Anhui province on October 20, 2026. The report says information about the programs’ status and development timeframe is currently scarce. The Lingxiao Q212 is an all-electric, two-seat eVTOL with a compound-wing and lift-and-cruise propulsion architecture. It should be able to reach speeds of up to 120 km/h, with around an hour of flight endurance at full load.
The other concept, Lingxiao J506, is a five-seat tiltrotor. Both aircraft are crewed. The report says the J506 is reported to have been designed to potentially support autonomous flights.

zh.title: TRV-150在佛州試驗中連續攔截多架攻擊無人機
zh.summary: TRV-150在佛州試驗中連續攔截多架攻擊無人機，未落地或重新裝填
body: BAE Systems於2026年10月21日公佈，TRV-150於2026年9月下旬在佛羅裏達州Eglin Air Force Base進行試驗，並在一次飛行中攔截多架單向攻擊無人機。試驗是Joint Readiness Experimentation演習的一部分。
這架以Malloy Aeronautics T-150重型載運無人機為基礎的武裝型機，使用搭載BAE Systems APKWS火箭的三聯裝發射器，連續接戰多個空中目標，期間未降落或重新裝填。BAE Systems未公佈攔截的無人機或發射火箭數量，也未說明目標身分及其導引方式。

en.title: TRV-150 intercepts multiple attack drones in Florida trial
en.summary: TRV-150 intercepted multiple attack drones in a Florida trial without landing to reload.
body: BAE Systems announced on October 21, 2026, that the TRV-150 intercepted multiple one-way attack drones during a single flight at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida. The trial took place in late September 2026 as part of a Joint Readiness Experimentation exercise.

The TRV-150 is an armed version of Malloy Aeronautics’ T-150 heavy-lift drone. It used a three-pod launcher carrying BAE Systems’ APKWS rockets to engage several airborne targets in succession without landing or reloading. BAE Systems did not specify how many drones were intercepted or rockets fired, and did not identify the targets or explain how they were designated.

zh.title: 新加坡航空公佈機上娛樂升級，KrisWorld將導入4K OLED螢幕
zh.summary: 新加坡航空公佈KrisWorld升級，將提供4K OLED螢幕與2,500項內容
body: 新加坡航空表示，已於2026年10月21日公佈機上娛樂（IFE）服務更新與升級。新一代KrisWorld平臺將配備4K OLED觸控螢幕，並提供空間音訊與藍牙配對功能；內容選項則達2,500項。
該航空公司也重新設計IFE系統介面，加入更清楚的選單、較大的圖示及改良搜尋與篩選功能，並新增迷你播放器，讓乘客在繼續觀看影片時同步搜尋內容與資訊。以KrisFlyer會員資料登入KrisWorld的乘客，將獲得個人化內容推薦與航班資訊，並可在不同航班間同步觀看紀錄。

en.title: Singapore Airlines announces upgraded KrisWorld inflight entertainment platform
en.summary: Singapore Airlines announced KrisWorld upgrades, including 4K OLED screens and 2,500 content options.
body: Singapore Airlines announced a refresh and upgrade of its inflight entertainment (IFE) offering on October 21, 2026. The new KrisWorld platform will feature 4K touchscreens with OLED technology, spatial audio and Bluetooth pairing. It will offer 2,500 content options.

The airline has also redesigned the IFE interface, with clearer menus, larger icons, improved search and filter functions, and a mini player that allows passengers to search for content and information while continuing to watch a film. Passengers who log in to KrisWorld using their KrisFlyer credentials will receive personalized content recommendations and flight information, and will be able to sync their viewing history across different flights.

zh.title: 亞美尼亞首架L-39 Skyfox現身空軍標誌
zh.summary: 亞美尼亞首架L-39 Skyfox現身空軍標誌，訂購數量尚未公佈
body: 亞美尼亞國防部公佈的照片顯示，國防部長Suren Papikyan正在檢視一架帶有亞美尼亞空軍標誌的L-39 Skyfox。Papikyan於2026年10月20日訪問Aero Vodochody工廠時，在Facebook貼文表示，這些飛機「很快將在亞美尼亞天空翱翔」。
捷克通訊社ČTK於2026年10月21日報導，最多四架飛機可能在未來數週交付亞美尼亞。Aero發言人表示未獲授權評論商業合作細節；雙方尚未正式公佈訂購數量、合約金額或交付時程。

en.title: Armenia’s first L-39 Skyfox appears in Air Force markings
en.summary: Armenia’s first L-39 Skyfox appears in Air Force markings; order details remain undisclosed
body: Photographs released by Armenia’s Ministry of Defense show Defense Minister Suren Papikyan inspecting an L-39 Skyfox bearing Armenian Air Force markings. During a visit to Aero Vodochody’s factory on October 20, 2026, Papikyan wrote on Facebook that the aircraft would “soon” fly in Armenia.

Czech news agency ČTK reported on October 21, 2026, that up to four aircraft could be delivered to Armenia in the coming weeks. An Aero spokesperson said the company was not authorized to comment on details of its commercial cooperation. Neither side has formally disclosed the number of aircraft ordered, the contract value or a delivery schedule.

zh.title: IATA與OneVasco合作 將簽證代辦服務整合至Timatic
zh.summary: IATA與OneVasco宣佈整合簽證服務，串接Timatic資訊與申請流程
body: IATA與OneVasco宣佈，OneVasco的簽證代辦服務將整合至IATA的Timatic Solutions。兩家公司表示，整合後將串接簽證資訊與申請服務，讓旅客可透過Timatic查詢入境要求後，直接進入簽證申請流程。
這項簽證服務將作為Timatic Solutions的補充選項提供航空公司，並納入Timatic Web及Timatic Widget。Timatic的旅遊資訊也將整合至OneVasco的簽證平臺。

en.title: IATA and OneVasco to integrate visa concierge service with Timatic
en.summary: IATA and OneVasco will link Timatic travel information with visa application services for travelers.
body: IATA and OneVasco announced that OneVasco’s visa concierge service will be integrated into IATA’s Timatic Solutions. The companies said the service will connect visa information and application services, letting travelers move from checking entry requirements through Timatic to applying for a visa.

The visa service will be offered to airlines as a supplementary option to Timatic Solutions, including integration with Timatic Web and Timatic Widget. Travel information from Timatic will also be incorporated into OneVasco’s visa platform.
